testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, and key metrics MUST have explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='upload-photo-dial', data-testid='unlock-report-button').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_rules: Ensure all text meets minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against navy dark surfaces. Use text-slate-100 for primary text and amber-300 for gold badges.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all user flows are smooth, mobile-responsive, and rich in horological details.
Use standard Lucide React or Radix icons for UI controls and watch specs.
Always render the legal disclaimer banner at the bottom of all generated identification reports.
Support mock scanning AI analysis with simulated loading stages (Uploading photos -> Extracting optical features -> Cross-referencing Omega Reference Database -> Calculating confidence score).
Persist user scans and admin reference database entries using localStorage or backend APIs seamlessly.
